description: This file contains tests for CLI container target parsing and container execution logic for the 'openclaw' project. It tests argument parsing, container resolution, and execution behavior within containerized environments using podman and docker.

methods.name: parseCliContainerArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract the '--container' flag and its value, along with the remaining arguments.

methods.name: resolveCliContainerTarget
methods.description: Resolves the container name from command-line arguments or environment variable 'OPENCLAW_CONTAINER'.

methods.name: maybeRunCliInContainer
methods.description: Determines if the CLI should be executed inside a container and if so, executes it via podman or docker, handling container checks and environment setup.
